'''2010 Dagobah Regionals Stephen Morgan LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Morgan]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WHAP 2010
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
